review: M3-C r1 law and contract soundness

requiredFindings.problem: The complete analysis-spec is assembled and admitted before snapshot sealing, imports, contexts and universe bindings that its required EnumerationPlanV1 parameter consumes.
evidence: Item 16 step 4 admits the spec; step 6 seals the snapshot, step 7 admits native imports and step 8 binds contexts/universes, despite the claim that every step consumes only admitted inputs.
evaluator-composition-contract.v3.md:9 requires exactly one EnumerationPlanV1 and one EvaluatorEmissionPlanV1 parameter in the spec.
enumeration-contract.v1.md:13-24,83-96 requires snapshotId and admitted selected context/universe bindings; item 18 requires every TypeScript universe's imports-cell population.
requiredFindings.fix: Separate early capability/cardinality checks from final spec admission. Construct/admit the complete spec after sealing, imports and context/universe binding, before prospective-Plan checks and plan2; preserve NE:4278 refusal ordering and add an available-program control proving admitted/retained/Plan-bound spec bytes are identical.

requiredFindings.problem: The gzip-plus-ustar, regular-physical-members-only extraction profile excludes GNU headers and long-name control records emitted by Cargo's package producer for otherwise legal regular output paths.
evidence: Cargo package source uses Header::new_gnu and append_data: https://docs.rs/cargo/latest/src/cargo/ops/cargo_package/mod.rs.html (source lines 899-911, inspected 2026-10-04).

The tar builder emits type L metadata named ././@LongLink for long names: https://docs.rs/tar/latest/src/tar/builder.rs.html (source lines 836-895). This physical record is not regular and is outside the package prefix.
NE:1681-1684 requires deterministic host extraction/manifests of authenticated locked tarballs and does not establish the proposed incompatible archive restriction.
requiredFindings.fix: Define a bounded Cargo-compatible GNU archive decoder profile. Admit only regular logical output files after decoding/validating effective paths; handle required long-name metadata, reject ambiguous extensions, links, devices, traversal and duplicate effective paths, and bound metadata/decompression work. Add a positive compatible long-path archive control. Any deliberate unsupported-format restriction needs an explicit contract disposition.

requiredFindings.problem: Nulling every observation member contradicts the exact ImportObservationV1 recipe, which requires schemaVersion 1 and a non-null kind.
evidence: NE:2708 specifies ImportObservationV1 {schemaVersion:1, kind, window|null, population|null, selection|null, revisionRange|null}.
workflows/schemas/imported-evidence.schema.json:246-264 requires all six fields and fixes schemaVersion to 1; kind references ImportKind.
NEM:401-402 supplies schemaVersion/kind and nulls only the four observation values.
requiredFindings.fix: Specify {schemaVersion:1, kind:<dependency or prepared>, window:null, population:null, selection:null, revisionRange:null}, join kind to the wrapper and retain/hash that admitted preimage. Add a wrapper control for each kind.

requiredFindings.problem: The revised DAG cannot preserve the claimed host-chain timing: C4a waits for C3b/C3c and is now L-sized, while the arithmetic considers only C2's split.
evidence: M3P:198 assigns S/M/L durations 1/2/3 days including review and integration; B2 finishes day 5.

Under the subject's explicit edges, C1a finishes 7, C3a 10, C3b 11 and C3c 12. C4a cannot start at 10 and its L duration finishes no earlier than 15; H then finishes no earlier than 18, versus M3P's 15.
The subject assigns five days to L-sized C2b and omits the C3b unit duration despite D1 being ready. Gating C2c integration on C3b can delay further.
schedule_estimates.json records optimistic authoring and stricter integration interpretations; these are planning counterexamples, not product runs.
requiredFindings.fix: Recalculate the full revised DAG, reconcile sizes/durations, distinguish authoring and integration edges, and update M3P-C and the critical-path claim. Include serialized X12d X9 evidence completion before J2 when establishing whether X12d beside H adds delay.
